title: Agent runs: ask for a run on the forge, follow it, stop it
summary: A maintainer asks for an agent run with a button or an agent token; the request is a comment on the forge, cornfield records the run, follows it by its trailer and reports, and can ask it to stop.

add.label: agent-runs.js
add.desc: Asks for runs (the cap, one per issue and profile, in one transaction with the insert) and follows them: trailers, reports from runners and maintainers only, state derived, hooks once.

add.label: agent-api.js
add.desc: POST /api/agent-requests with an agent token, and the dashboard's run routes.

add.label: runs-model.js
add.desc: The words of the runs list and of Start an agent.

scenarios.title: A maintainer asks for a run and stops it

steps.text: A maintainer presses Start an agent on an issue and confirms.
The request is checked and posted as a comment as them.
The cap and the one-run rule are taken in one transaction with the insert.
The poll follows the run: the runner's report moves its state; a stop request is posted the same way.
